docRequirement: whats-new/2026-w16.md:125 binds us to: "`PreCompact` hooks can block compaction by exiting with code 2 or returning `{"decision":"block"}`". hooks.md:733 repeats it as a table row ("| `PreCompact` | Yes | Blocks compaction |"), hooks.md:868/:893 list `PreCompact` among the nine top-level-`decision` events ("The only value is `\"block\"`"), and hooks.md:2655 spells out both channels plus the user-facing behaviour: "Exit with code 2 to block compaction. For a manual `/compact`, the stderr message is shown to the user. You can also block by returning JSON with `\"decision\": \"block\"`." hooks.md:2657 fixes what a blocked auto-compact does: a proactive compaction is skipped and "the conversation continues uncompacted"; a compaction triggered to recover from a context-limit error lets "the underlying error surface". hooks.md:2661 also binds the input to `trigger` and `custom_instructions`.
current: The decision surface is fully built and the consumer is missing on the default runtime. `PreCompact` is the ninth entry of `TOP_LEVEL_BLOCK_EVENTS` (packages/shared/src/automations/hook-decision-contract.ts:49), so `projectHookDecisionForEvent` (same file:306) passes `block`/`deny` + `reason` through, and an imported plugin hook exiting 2 is turned into `{ decision: 'block' }` by `getHookCommandPreToolDecision` (packages/shared/src/automations/hook-command.ts:600-605). The event is authored-for on real surfaces: packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-runtime.ts:49,182 and packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters.ts:147,182,199,213 (Claude `PreCompact`, Codex `pre_compact`/`preCompact`), plus packages/session-tools-core/src/handlers/automation-management.ts. Nothing on Pi consumes the result. The only emitter is packages/pi-agent-server/src/extensions/lifecycle-bridge.ts:149-154, whose handler `await options.emit('PreCompact', …)` and then returns `undefined`; `emit` is declared `Promise<void> | void` at :28 and is wrapped by the fire-and-forget gate at :37-48, and it is bound to `lifecycleEventSink: (event, input) => { send({ type: 'automation_event', event, input }) }` at packages/pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:1969. On the host, packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:2340 dispatches that message with `void this.emitAutomationEvent(...)` — the return value is discarded at the call site. The two host-side sites that DO act on a block cover other events only: `runPiPromptGate` (pi-agent.ts:6430) is gated by `hookBlockEndsTurn`, which is true only for `ALWAYS_TERMINAL_BLOCK_EVENTS` = UserPromptSubmit/UserPromptExpansion/PostToolBatch (hook-decision-contract.ts:238-242, :295-299) and iterates `PI_PROMPT_GATE_EVENTS` (pi-agent.ts:404) only; `handlePostToolUseRequest` (pi-agent.ts:3575-3632) serves PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure. The veto primitive exists in Pi and we simply do not use it: both compaction paths in node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/core/agent-session.js honour a handler return — manual at :1315-1332 (`if (result?.cancel) throw new Error("Compaction cancelled")`) and auto at :1544-1563 (`compaction_end` with `aborted: true`, returns false) — and `SessionBeforeCompactResult` is `{ cancel?: boolean; compaction?: CompactResult }` (node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-agent-core/dist/harness/types.d.ts:488-491). Our sibling handler in the same file already returns values Pi consumes (`autoCompactionExtension`, packages/pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:1346-1383, returns `{ cancel: true }` and `{ compaction }`), and the `tool_result` seam two blocks above the compaction one does the awaited round trip we are missing (lifecycle-bridge.ts:129-148 -> `requestPostToolUseTransform`, index.ts:2056-2075). Internal doc rot: hook-decision-contract.ts:236 still records "`ConfigChange`/`PreCompact` are advisory", which hooks.md:719 and :733 now contradict for both. The bridge also omits the documented `custom_instructions` input field although the Pi event carries `customInstructions` (agent-session.js:1320). Only the Claude Agent SDK backend honours the block, via `automationResultToSdkHookResult` (packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-automation.ts:1673-1681) mapping any blocking decision to `{ continue: false, decision: 'block', reason }` — and that backend is off unless `NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE` is set at build time.
divergence: Not a key-name or value mismatch — the parsed decision is already correct and correctly spelled. The delta is one missing awaited round trip: the `PreCompact` emission on Pi is fire-and-forget (`Promise<void> | void`, lifecycle-bridge.ts:28), so a `block` that the contract layer produced has no path back to the `session_before_compact` handler's return value, and Pi's `{ cancel: true }` is therefore never returned. Exit code 2 is inert for the same reason (it becomes the same discarded `{ decision: 'block' }`). Scope: Pi only. The identical hook blocks correctly on the Claude backend (hooks-automation.ts:1673-1681), so the divergence is per-runtime, not global — and Pi is the default and the only backend enabled by default.

change.what: Add an optional callback beside `transformToolResult` (:30-36): `requestCompactionDecision?(input: { trigger: 'manual' | 'auto'; source: string; customInstructions?: string }): Promise<{ block?: boolean; reason?: string } | void> | { block?: boolean; reason?: string } | void`. In the handler at :149-154, when the callback is present, `await` IT INSTEAD OF `options.emit('PreCompact', …)` (one emission only — keeping both makes the host run the hook twice per compaction) and `return { cancel: true }` when it answers `block`; when it is absent keep today's fire-and-forget emit so other embedders and the existing tests are unchanged. Wrap the call in try/catch returning `undefined`: `runner.emit` swallows a handler throw (pi-coding-agent/dist/core/extensions/runner.js:539-548), so a throw would both fail open and lose the reason. Also add the documented `custom_instructions` field to the emitted input from `event.customInstructions` (hooks.md:2661; the event carries it, agent-session.js:1320) and widen the handler's event type to `{ reason?: string; customInstructions?: string }`.

Add `requestCompactionDecision?` with the same signature to the options interface beside `transformToolResult` (:87-88) and forward it into `createPiLifecycleExtension` at :270-274 with the same conditional spread used for `transformToolResult` at :273. No other change in this file — the lifecycle extension is already registered BEFORE `autoCompactionExtension` (:274-285), which is the order the fix depends on.

(4) Add `function requestPreCompactDecision(input)` as a copy of `requestPostToolUseTransform` (:2056-2075) — set the pending entry, `send({ type: 'pre_compact_request', … })`, return the promise — and stash the answered reason in a module-level `let lastPreCompactBlockReason: string | undefined`. (7) Pass `requestCompactionDecision: requestPreCompactDecision` at BOTH `runtimeAdapter.createSession` sites, next to `transformToolResult` at :1970 and :3032 — missing the second one leaves the regenerated-session path unblocked. Add `case 'pre_compact_request':` beside the `post_tool_use_request` case (:2357) dispatching `void this.handlePreCompactRequest(msg as { requestId: string; trigger: 'manual' | 'auto'; source: string; customInstructions?: string })`. Add `private async handlePreCompactRequest(req)` modelled on `handlePostToolUseRequest` (:3575-3632): capture `sourceChild = this.subprocess` and `responseEpoch = this.subprocessResponseEpoch`; `await this.emitAutomationEvent('PreCompact', { hook_event_name: 'PreCompact', trigger: req.trigger, ...(req.customInstructions ? { custom_instructions: req.customInstructions } : {}) })` wrapped in the same `Promise.race` timeout used by `awaitPromptGateDecision` (:6445-6460) so a hung hook cannot stall compaction indefinitely; on `isBlockingHookDecision(result?.decision)` (imported at :127) log `this.debug(`__HOOK_BLOCK__${JSON.stringify({ event: 'PreCompact', applied: true })}`)` and `this.send({ type: 'pre_compact_response', requestId: req.requestId, block: true, reason })`, otherwise `this.send({ type: 'pre_compact_response', requestId: req.requestId })`. Keep the same staleness guard as the post-tool handler (`if (this.subprocess !== sourceChild || this.subprocessResponseEpoch !== responseEpoch) return;`) and fail open (send a non-blocking response) on any thrown error. If the bridge is instead left emitting `PreCompact` through the sink as well, `'PreCompact'` must be added to the echo-drop guard at :2336 — the single-emission design above avoids that.

userImpact: Observable today on the default build. A user who adds a PreCompact automation with a blocking action (Automations surface / packages/session-tools-core/src/handlers/automation-management.ts), or installs a Claude plugin whose `PreCompact` hook exits 2, watches the hook run and the compaction happen anyway: typing `/compact` still returns "Compacted context to fit within limits …" (pi-agent.ts:6363) and the history is summarised away, and auto-compaction at the context threshold does the same. Nothing tells them the block was dropped — the reason is parsed, then discarded at pi-agent.ts:2340, and no `__HOOK_BLOCK__` line is even logged for this event. The concrete loss is the guard case the doc exists for: "do not compact while this plan is mid-execution" / "snapshot before compacting" cannot be enforced, and a hook author who tested against Claude Code sees the opposite behaviour here. It is not latent and not uniform: rebuild with `NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE=1` and run the Claude backend and the same hook blocks correctly (hooks-automation.ts:1673-1681), so the same configuration behaves two ways depending on the backend.
